name: motif_edit_inflectional_affix
description:
Edit an inflectional affix. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Use only if an inflectional affix belongs in other slots of its category; otherwise author a slot with compose-author-affix-slot. Never copy an affix per slot or per stem class (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Changes which existing category slots an inflectional affix MSA uses. Other MSA kinds and slots outside the category hierarchy are refused; Motif stages a Draft and never Applies it automatically. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-inflectional-affix. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing inflectional affix MSA.

expected_slots.description: Current slot ids assigned to the MSA.

slots.description: Requested slot ids; order has no meaning.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
